description: JSON Schema for listing_observation class in Elephant Lexicon

asking_price_amount_minor.description: Asking price in minor currency units when parsing succeeded. Zero is never a valid parsed asking price.

asking_price_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the parsed asking price.

authority_state.description: Authority assigned to this source for sale-availability assessment.

coverage_state.description: Coverage of the provider lookup for the requested subject.

evidence_artifact_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of the exact evidence artifact bytes.

evidence_artifact_uri.description: URI of the immutable evidence artifact supporting this observation.

exact_address_match_state.description: Whether the provider evidence identifies the exact address that was requested.

freshness_policy_version.description: Version of the policy used to evaluate freshness_state.

market_status.description: Canonical market status interpreted from the provider evidence.

observation_identifier.description: Deterministic lowercase SHA-256 identity derived from provider, source request or listing identity, retrieval time, and evidence artifact digest.

observation_outcome.description: Outcome of this provider lookup. A failed lookup is not evidence that a listing is absent.

price_parse_status.description: Price parsing result. REJECTED requires a null asking_price_amount_minor and must never be represented as zero.

provider_identifier.description: Stable identifier for the provider that supplied the observation.

retrieved_at.description: Timestamp when the source evidence was retrieved.

source_as_of.description: Provider-declared effective timestamp for the source record when available.

source_listing_identifier.description: Provider listing identifier when the source supplied one.

source_request_identifier.description: Stable identifier for the source request that produced this observation.

source_status.description: Unmodified provider status value when available.

source_url.description: Source listing or lookup URL when available.

title: listing_observation
